criteria.title: Org transport class is explicit
criteria.assertion: PSTF and user docs classify org browser operations as nostr_request_result_facade rather than nostr_native public read models.

criteria.title: Encrypted request ingress validates NIP-01 trust boundary
criteria.assertion: Encrypted request transport rejects invalid inbound events before handler dispatch.

criteria.title: Org domain facade remains encrypted and scoped
criteria.assertion: Org CRUD/membership/invite handlers operate through encrypted 5980/7980 request/result operations with org domain scoping and repository-backed state.
